requirements.title: Consent screen for personal data
requirements.description: Because personal data must follow the DPDP Act, 2023, the system must provide a consent screen.

requirements.title: Personal data deletion
requirements.description: To follow the DPDP Act, 2023, the system must support deletion of personal data.

requirements.title: Breach handling for personal data
requirements.description: To follow the DPDP Act, 2023, the system must support handling of personal data breaches.

requirements.title: Project check on every request
requirements.description: Because one common backend serves all projects, the system must check the project on every request.

rules.title: OTP SMS templates registered under TRAI DLT
rules.description: OTP SMS templates must be registered under TRAI DLT rules. This needs 1–2 weeks lead time before launch.

rules.title: One common backend for all projects
rules.description: All projects must use one common backend.

rules.title: DPDP Act, 2023 compliance
rules.description: Personal data must follow the DPDP Act, 2023.

rules.title: Raghuvir creates only Society Managers
rules.description: Raghuvir only creates Society Managers and does not approve residents. All approvals depend on an active Society Manager.
